summary: Official Startup School URL redirects to the current CSX accelerator page, but no current 2026 application window, next cohort dates, or cadence is publicly posted. Latest official cohort details found are for CSX 04 in San Francisco in spring 2025, now past.

sources.title: Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)
sources.supports: Official page confirms the program is now branded Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX) and describes capital, expert network, mentorship/support, web3 cohort, and company-building topics, but does not publish current application dates.

sources.title: Apply to Join the CSX 04 Cohort in San Francisco this Spring
sources.supports: Official post states CSX 04 applications were due February 7, 2025, the program would run April-June 2025 in San Francisco, and a16z invests at least $500,000 in accepted companies.

sources.title: Announcing the CSX 04 Cohort in San Francisco
sources.supports: Official post confirms CSX 04 started the week of March 31, 2025 in San Francisco, lasted about two months, and connected founders with a16z crypto investing/operating teams, capital, industry experts, and web3 teams.

notes: The named accelerator appears to have evolved from Crypto Startup School to Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX).
Because the only dated official cohort information found is in the past relative to 2026-06-09, no current event record should be added without further manual confirmation.
The official application domain at csx.a16zcrypto.com shows a login flow rather than public cohort/application details.
